author: iKerrigan
body:
Username iKerrigan
Banned since last year (13 months)
Banned for hacking
Appealed before, received an email saying I was unbanned, but never happened (I have received an email saying I was unbanned by housie, who was the owner at that time)
I guess I had enough time to reflect on my action... I am pretty sure one year is enough.
